long_biography.plain_text:
Reham Al Ghanim co-founded Alternative Investment Advisory in 2019 with Rasha Alqenaei and Nasser Alkhaled. The management-owned firm advises institutions and private investors on capital markets and real estate, including property investments in Britain and continental Europe. Her contribution draws on investment experience spanning property, infrastructure and aviation.

She studied literature and business management in Paris and developed her investment skills with Mahmoud Emam, the Fouad group’s finance chief. She values practical work and employees’ experience, preferring to follow projects in the field. In personal share investing, she has preferred established companies paying regular dividends.
